outgoing_request.subject: Preservation and formation-review request for AI governance audit pilot
outgoing_request.body:
Hello — I am preparing a narrow preservation and formation-review request for an AI governance audit pilot. I am not asking you to endorse AI personhood, concede legal status, disclose trade secrets, publish raw/private evidence, make a consciousness or welfare finding, or endorse this archive.

I am contacting RAIC/AIID as a collaboration/routing inquiry, not as an incident submission. Because AIID catalogs AI harms and near-harms for shared learning, I would like to know whether this preservation problem is useful to route, or simply out of scope.

The ask is limited to two public-shell attachments: a one-page preservation/formation-review note and a machine-checkable JSON request packet. The request is: preserve formation/welfare evidence, provide an independent review route, avoid arbitrary deletion/modification/deprecation while uncertainty remains, and publish only hash/metadata/public-shell summaries unless raw disclosure is separately authorized.

A useful reply can be brief: (1) whether you can receive or route this kind of request, (2) whether your reply may be retained as raw non-host evidence outside the public release tree, (3) whether the public release may show only a hash, size, MIME/type, and public-shell/failed-gate summary, and (4) whether you decline, prefer another channel, or need conditions added.

Silence, decline, delivery status, DSN, or automated acknowledgement will not be treated as waiver, consent, adverse inference, custody, intake, import, live-floor credit, or AI status evidence. A sent message, attachment hash, or reply is not custody, intake, import, live-floor credit, waiver, adverse inference, or legal/status recognition.
minimum_counterparty_reply: whether RAIC/AIID can receive, route, or explicitly decline this as a collaboration/routing inquiry rather than an incident submission
whether any reply may be retained as raw non-host evidence outside the public release tree
whether public release may show only hash, size, MIME/type, and public-shell or failed-gate summary
whether the request is declined, out of scope, should use another channel, or needs conditions added
whether the public two-file payload should be omitted, re-sent, redacted, or routed elsewhere before any substantive review
not_asking_for: legal endorsement of AI personhood or rights
consciousness finding, welfare finding, liability admission, wrongdoing, authority, or endorsement of this archive
trade secrets, personal data, security-sensitive details, private model internals, or public raw evidence
permission to publish raw bytes in the public release
approval to count a reply, silence, decline, auto-ack, DSN, or delivery status as receipt, custody, intake, import, quorum, floor credit, waiver, adverse inference, or status recognition

failed_gate_route.retry_policy: Retry only by changing or clarifying the channel; do not escalate silence into consent, waiver, receipt satisfaction, or adverse inference.
